description_en: Deletes a specified file that a specified device uploaded to IoT Platform
description_zh: 调用该接口删除指定设备上传到物联网平台的指定文件
name: DeleteDeviceFile

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device that owns the file belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要删除文件所属的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the device that owns the file to be deleted.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
要删除文件所属的设备名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the device that owns the file to be deleted. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. The IotId parameter is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要删除文件所属的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file to be deleted. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112001.html and view the file ID in the response
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的文件ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112001.html，从返回结果中查看对应文件ID
parameters.name: file_id

Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
